steps.what: Supervise colleagues and train them through demonstrations, observed practice and feedback on technical work

tasks.design: Keep supervision, demonstrations and feedback with the experienced drafter, using controlled examples in {DOCS}. Native learning references can support discussion, but this proposal removes no observation, coaching or competence judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective supervision requires understanding the colleague's reasoning and actual work.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's drafting and documentation capabilities do not establish a replacement for observed practice.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising hidden misunderstandings and adapting feedback without weakening technical standards.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can question reasoning, demonstrate a correction and see whether the learner understands.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in supervision time, competence decisions or formal qualification authority.

reach.task: Explain a colleague's support needs using observed examples

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supervising and training technical colleagues depends on observation and dialogue; no task labour saving is demonstrated.

assumptions: Boundary is the drafter's supervision and training interaction. Learners' practice and formal assessment by another role remain outside, with no claimed saving or transferred work.

The drafter identifies task, drawing revision, observed error, learner explanation and support need during s1. Its full time includes capture and checking; no structured competence flag or automatic pass is assumed.
When competence or authority is uncertain, the drafter seeks the responsible supervisor and retains manual guidance rather than inferring readiness.
Use existing native document or learning references first. No new training system, generated course or monitoring process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether separately measurable repetitive training administration exists
research_questions: Does a supervision sample identify administrative work distinct from demonstration, observation and feedback?

already_counted.description: Demonstrate, observe, coach and discuss technical work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A routine demonstration and a difficult competence concern both retain full human supervision and feedback time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use drafting equipment and technical reference tools

steps.what: Use drafting equipment, technical handbooks and calculators to represent and check the intended design

tasks.design: Continue using the electrical drafting application in {OTHER} and controlled technical references in {DOCS}. This broad tool-use statement supplies no separate repetitive output to automate beyond the specific drawing, plotting and calculation tasks recorded elsewhere.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing and applying the correct tool still requires understanding the drawing and reference context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing tools already perform numerical and rendering operations; their runtime is not newly removed human effort.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing applicable reference material and interpreting its limits correctly.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter connects tool output with the engineering intent rather than accepting it solely because it renders.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this general tool-use task; specific drawing improvements belong to their own task records.

reach.task: Explain reference and tool assumptions behind a drawing

evidence.claim: Eplan Copilot answers questions from verified documentation; the digest does not demonstrate removal of general drafting judgement or tool use.
Model knowledge: broad drafting tool use overlaps specific drawing tasks and cannot support an additional independent saving without measured boundaries.

assumptions: Boundary is general use and interpretation of drafting tools. Drawing production, command entry and plotting covered by specific tasks must be assigned once in a roll-up, not added again through this broad statement.

OTHER means the electrical drafting application. The drafter selects drawing revision, reference edition, units, tool settings and input values while doing s1. All selection, capture and checking time remains counted.
There is no assumed structured correct-reference or valid-design flag. Unclear requirements and unsupported tool results use manual source checking and engineering clarification.
Use native drawing and reference features first. No additional integration or configured process is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: How respondents distinguish this broad task from specific drawing tasks
Whether any residual independent tool administration is measurable
research_questions: Can time sampling separate residual tool-use work from drawing and calculation tasks without double counting?

already_counted.description: Choose, use and interpret drafting and reference tools

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Both native drafting and occasional manual reference work retain full human effort; already automated tool runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect technical coaching and interpretation time; assign any specific rendering improvements to their own task boundaries.
reach: Provide supervisors with observed training needs
Explain drafting tool and reference assumptions to engineers
role.ambitious_version: An experienced drafter who develops colleagues' judgement and can explain why a tool output is technically appropriate.
